clauses.reason: This clause ("(b) In accordance with the Act, the Council shall terminate 2 years from the date of this order, unless extended by the President.") was carried into EO 13265 as signed on 2002-06-06. Three orders revised the clause: EO 13545 (signed 2010-06-22), EO 13824 (signed 2018-02-26) and EO 14327 (signed 2025-07-31). EO 13824 and EO 14327 introduce the revision with the words "Sections 1 through 5 are revised to read as follows", and EO 13545 revises sections 1 through 5 in the same way; none of the three states a separate effective date, so each took effect on signing. Under the owner ruling of 2026-10-21 on strike-and-insert and "to read as follows" amendments the clause continues, amended, while EO 13265 continues, and the reviewer should note that the whole section was replaced and the substance changed. In the current text, the corresponding subsection now reads "(g) In accordance with the Act, the Council shall terminate 2 years from the date of this order, unless extended by the President. (h)".  The clause is a contingent end: the Council terminates two years from the date of the order "unless extended by the President" (two years from 2002-06-06 is 2004-06-06). The President extended it by the biennial continuation orders, each effective 2003-09-30 and every second year after, the first (EO 13316) continuing it before the two years ran and each later order taking effect on the day the previous continuance ran out; the latest, EO 14354 (effective 2025-09-30), says "Each advisory committee listed below is continued until September 30, 2027" and lists "President’s Council on Sports, Fitness, and Nutrition; Executive Order 13265, as amended (Department of Health and Human Services)". So the contingent end has not occurred, and the Council was continued through 2026-10-14. Each continuance order is a later event on this clause.

Sec. 5(c) says "(c) Executive Order 12345 of February 2, 1982, as amended, is revoked." The revocation of EO 12345 was performed by the order itself; the order has no separate effective date, so it took effect on signing, 2002-06-06 (published 2002-06-11, 67 FR 39841). A revocation is a one-time act that is exhausted once performed, while its result, that EO 12345 stays revoked, does not depend on this clause staying in force. EO 14327 sec. 2(c) later restated the general provisions of EO 13265 with the same revocation, "Executive Order 12345 of February 2, 1982 (Physical Fitness and Sports), as amended, is revoked", which repeats the result and does not revive the command.

research_rationale:
The held official Federal Register text of EO 13265 (67 FR 39841, FR Doc. 02-14807, published 2002-06-11) was read in full. It establishes the President's Council on Physical Fitness and Sports, assigns the Secretary of Health and Human Services a purpose (sec. 1), sets membership (sec. 2), functions (sec. 3), administration (sec. 4) and general provisions (sec. 5), with a two-year termination unless extended and the revocation of EO 12345. The 25-clause inventory (each section and each lettered subsection) was confirmed against the text. Sections 1 through 5 were revised to read as follows three times (EO 13545 in 2010, held only as a presidency-project mirror capture of its text, EO 13824 in 2018 and EO 14327 in 2025), and EO 14048 amended the 2018 text in 2021; under the owner ruling of 2026-10-21 each clause continues, amended, while the order continues, and each revision is a later event on each clause with the substance change disclosed. The contingent two-year end in sec. 5(b) has not occurred because the President extended the Council by the biennial continuation orders from EO 13316 (2003) to EO 14354 (2025), which continues it until 2027-09-30 and lists the Council as established by EO 13265 as amended. Sec. 5(c) revoked EO 12345 once, on signing. The Office of the Federal Register catalogue lists EO 13316, EO 13385, EO 13545, EO 13824 and EO 14327 as amending and the continuation orders as continuing the order, and lists no revocation. The held text of EO 14045 (signed 2021-09-13) is the order on the White House Initiative on Advancing Educational Equity for Hispanics; the character span at which the dossier records an amendment of EO 13265 in that file holds that order's own text about its working group and not an amendment of EO 13265, so EO 14045 is not used and EO 14048 sec. 7 is the 2021 amendment. The U.S. Code search covers editions current through 2026-10-09, so a law enacted from 2026-10-10 to 2026-10-14 is not reflected.

savings.reason: EO 13265 has no savings clause. Its only revocation, sec. 5(c) of EO 12345, carries no proviso preserving anything under the revoked order. The later instruments that revise the order (EO 13545, EO 13824, EO 14327 and EO 14048) contain no provision preserving or ending rights under the original text beyond their own general provisions, which state that nothing in them impairs the authority of departments or the functions of the Director of the Office of Management and Budget.
